reviews.title: Never orders to closest store
reviews.text: Every other app for mobile ordering lists the closest store to you as the first option, but this one doesn’t. Triple check you order to the right store because CAVA doesn’t help their customers by making it for you if ordered to the wrong place. Just moved to a new state and don’t know my way around yet so had this just hasten to me and now my salad is going to be all soggy by the time I finally get to it. Thanks CAVA!!!

reviews.title: UI/UX is Trash!
reviews.text: After repeated attempts, the app will not let me add to my order.  I wanted to build a 2nd bowl, but this app refuses to let me do it.  On the 5th try, my bag (the cart) completely disappeared entirely. I even removed all items from the bag prior to it disappearing and started from scratch. However, it still didn’t work, so I uninstalled the  app, did a hard reset on my phone, reinstalled the app, and it’s still doing the same thing!  Trash app with bad UI/UX!  Fire your developers!

reviews.title: Slow ordering. Too much loading.
reviews.text: Doing anything in this app is met with loading screens. Even simply updating a quantity or reordering your last order there are long loading times. Need to make the experience faster like other competing apps.

reviews.title: Poor user experience
reviews.text:
I love Cava, but the ordering experience is frustrating. In order to redeem a reward, I have to click “Redeem” first and then start my order… why can I not just redeem my reward at the end of my order??

The amount of times I’ve finished adding items to my order, then remembered I have rewards, only to find out that in order to redeem it, it CLEARS my cart and I have to start over again. WHY?? Awful user experience.

I also want to be able to quickly jump to a certain part of my bowl-building process, but I have to constantly scroll back and forth. Make it easier to jump to a certain part of the bowl!

reviews.title: Paywall/Online order.
reviews.text: I was trying to order two bowls under my Apple Pay card for a mobile pickup. I ended up putting the two bowls in my cart and proceeded to pay. I got charged and I didn’t even get no email for anything. I have been charged and now I can’t even eat. Don’t use this app if you’re trying to order. May be best to just go in person because they just sack you out of your money.

reviews.title: Cannot join rewards
reviews.text: Despite trying on 3 different days to fill out the account info, there is sone kind of glitch where the info will not "join now" . No error messages appear and I checked thru for spelling, all was well, because of this I can't scan my receipt for points. Frustrating !

reviews.text: My points were stolen. Used by someone in New York. There should be a mechanism in place to confirm. They stole over 1,000 plus points and the store allowed them to on several different purchases.

reviews.title: Only lets me use Apple Pay
reviews.text: For some reason, I can only pay via Apple Pay in the app. If I try to add a credit card, I get the message that says the card is already on the account even though it doesn’t look like I have any cards to choose from so it forces me to add one each time. This makes it so that I cannot use my work card to place a cava order since I am not able to put my work card into ApplePay. Would love if this could be fixed! It would mean I could order, more frequently as a work meal, whereas now I have to pick somewhere else if I want to order ahead

reviews.title: App is Terrible
reviews.text: This app needs a lot of help. Quite often it doesn’t work at all. But then the user interface is not good. You start off with the splash screen that offers you the ability to add a previous order item which once you figure out that the clock icon means a previous order you’re good, but it’s not obvious that the clock means a previous order. However, if you get to the splash screen and instead hit the start new order button, the clock with your previous orders disappears, and you no longer have the ability to select previous orders. Let’s say you’re ordering for two people and one person wants a previous order and the other person doesn’t if you choose a previous order and it’s added to your bag you can’t now just start another menu item. You have to go to the bag first and then add another order to the bag. Why? Makes no sense.

reviews.title: Love the food, not the UI
reviews.text: The food is great and I consistently order from there. The UI is a disgrace to front end software engineers globally. It intentionally uses as little as possible of the open space on your phone screen while 50% of the screen remains blank. The UI elements are designed such that it is harder to undo your options (hiding the "x" behind the time). This comes across to me as predatory, but in accordance with Hanlon's razor I choose to assume this is incompetence as the elements seem randomly jumbled. This and the food are why I give 2 stars instead of 1.

reviews.title: Not Pleased
reviews.text: Placed a to go order on app. Made 2 stops before arriving and still had to wait 30 minutes for my order. There were several other people waiting for their to go orders when I arrived as well and they were not happy either. Meanwhile other customers who walked in were being served with no wait. I would have been better off just coming in and going through the line but was trying to avoid having to bring kids in to wait. No one from the staff was rude but no one went out of their way to accommodate the several customers patiently waiting for their to go orders either or even apologize for the unexplained wait. Also did not care for the cleanliness of the store and how one individual kept going from the kitchen to the front and touching the trash can that kept getting in the way at the door into the kitchen.

reviews.title: Disappointed Today
reviews.text: Food always tastes delicious, however service was lacking. I placed an order for pickup. Firstly it was over 10 minutes late from the  time estimated. Not such a big deal. But upon grabbing my order and checking it, the meal was missing SEVERAL of the ingredients I asked for. I waited an additional 5-6 minutes for someone to acknowledge me. When I informed her of the situation, she rudely responds “Whatever is missing, we don’t have,” and walks off. I then say that the app should know what’s available or not and inform the customer when placing the order. She ignored me. Did not offer to replace any of the missing items with something else or anything. I respectfully asked another employee if I could have some extra tzatziki for the missing feta and dressings, of which he did thankfully oblige. It was just an overall let down from the usual decent service we have received at other occasions.

reviews.title: Delicious but…
reviews.text:
Don’t do pick up at the Willis tower. I set my lunch pick up to 11:15 am. It’s 11:45 am and there’s no news of my food being ready. There’s a line of people who are standing at the pickup area and I don’t even know why they’re all standing there. Are they doing first come first serve? Idk. 

***update: Ok. So wait time after ordering your food via app is 30-45 mins during lunch hours. Probably longer if you order it now and expect to pick it up ASAP. 

Also, portions are smaller when ordering via app versus ordering in person. Bowl has more empty space than my forehead.

reviews.title: Rewards system is a joke
reviews.text:
Back in the day you used to get value for your rewards. Now you get way less while spending more. 1800 points back in the day was for a free bowl or pita. And I think it was less way back when. Now this year they went up to 2100 for free bowl of pita. So it’s safe to say they’re gonna keep going up on points every year. That’s just ridiculous. This adds up a lot, especially when you’re doing an online order and sometimes depending who’s making your order, you get less food. 

This is very disappointing. I see no point in signing up for any rewards program you’re just spending more money and getting less.

reviews.title: Love the food, hate the app
reviews.text: This app is so slow that it takes me about five minutes to place an order. Hear me out. I know what I want, I’m pressing the buttons, but there is such a lag between every addition or subtraction from the cart that I’m just waiting for everything to constantly load. It’s not very intuitive for the user as I have to constantly come out of my current order to go add my previous favorites. Why is that not easily accessible from the ordering platform? Also, it’s super hard to find. Why isn’t under the Account at least? Please do better. It shouldn’t take longer to place the order than it does to prepare the food.

reviews.title: Completely Fake
reviews.text: Been ordering from the app for awhile and while the UI isn’t the best and the app continues to seem clunky even when just trying to place a simple order I was willing to forgive that, but on top of the fact that on random days they just don’t have any pitas and are missing half of the ingredient menu, they even just assumed one time that they could give me the completely wrong order because I’m assuming they didn’t have the ingredients even though the app said they did?? It also doesn’t help that there is no support resource of any kind like with DoorDash to get a refund once you’ve been given something you didn’t pay for. Terrible interface, no communication platform and little to no competency on the part of cava with this app. If you want cava just use DoorDash like they’re already falsely doing by hiring DoorDash drivers to actually bring you the food.
